approvers: My adviser or broker, my tax adviser, my spouse, and the buyer's house bank
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed money wants my life's work. I would never hand my staff and my name to a company like that, however nicely it is written.
objection: Belize, no track record, no funding committed. Thirty percent of the price is paid over three years by a company that may not exist by then, and nobody can tell me my people will be safe.
instead: Keep running the business, talk to my adviser about a listing on nexxt-change, or look for a local buyer or a successor from within the company. Winding it down is the last resort.
would_change_my_mind: Funding already committed and shown by a German bank, a named EU-registered owner with real references from earlier owners, and a larger share of the price paid in cash at closing or secured by a bank guarantee.
